name: Albemarle County, VA
findings: Albemarle County has 905 nonprofit organizations. 407 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 337 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Albemarle County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Albemarle County list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 198 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
